SOPS/age secret management shared with central repo

nodes.label: Substituto do KSOPS para validação offline (pre-commit e CI, sem chave age).…
nodes.norm_label: substituto do ksops para validacao offline (pre-commit e ci, sem chave age)....

nodes.label: Cluster age recipient key (KSOPS)
nodes.rationale: Private half in Secret argocd/sops-age, used by ArgoCD's KSOPS; the central CI test key must never be added because it is public

nodes.label: SOPS creation rules (deploy/**.sops.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Encrypts everything except apiVersion/metadata/kind/type for files under deploy/; recipients are the same public age keys as the central repo

nodes.label: WSL age recipient key
nodes.rationale: Private half only in WSL ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt

nodes.label: yamllint configuration
nodes.rationale: Ignores *.sops.yaml (encrypted content), line length 160, strict truthy and forbids octal values

nodes.label: Make targets (deps, install, dev, run, test)
nodes.norm_label: make targets (deps, install, dev, run, test)

nodes.label: actionlint ubuntu-26.04 runner label
nodes.rationale: actionlint v1.7.12 does not yet know the hosted ubuntu-26.04 runner, so it is declared as a self-hosted label to avoid false lint errors

nodes.label: CI e2e job (k3s on runner)
nodes.rationale: Spins up k3s pinned to the central repo's version (installer sha256 pinned), imports the job-built image, applies deploy/base and checks Available + /healthz == ok

nodes.label: Release summary (central repo values snippet)
nodes.rationale: Prints the apps.<name> targetRevision snippet to paste in a PR to the central repo, since publishing to the cluster happens there

nodes.label: Digest to kustomization, commit and tag
nodes.norm_label: digest to kustomization, commit and tag
nodes.source_location: steps.Digest na kustomization, commit e tag

nodes.label: Release workflow job
nodes.rationale: Single way to produce a version: build+push ghcr image, write digest into kustomization, commit and tag on main, create GitHub Release

nodes.label: deploy/base kustomization
nodes.rationale: No namespace (comes from the Application destination) and no Ingress, so it is what runs in CI without a tailnet; app.kubernetes.io/name label with includeSelectors fills empty selectors

nodes.label: kustomization images: app-image digest
nodes.rationale: Managed by scripts/set-image.sh; must stay at the end of the file; always by digest

nodes.label: Tailscale overlay kustomization
nodes.rationale: Used on the notebook cluster (tailscaleOperator.enabled in the central repo): base + tailnet Ingress

nodes.label: Dependabot Docker base image updates
nodes.rationale: Updates the Dockerfile base image digest together with its tag weekly

nodes.label: Central repo bernats-homelab/2026-kubernetes
nodes.rationale: Only declares the ArgoCD Application apps.grocery-ops in kubernetes/apps/values.yaml pinned to a vX.Y.Z tag of this repo

nodes.label: Images always by digest
nodes.rationale: The app image in images: is only changed by release.yaml via scripts/set-image.sh

nodes.label: CI lint job (pre-commit)
nodes.rationale: Runs exactly the same pre-commit config as WSL so local and CI checks match

nodes.label: Template placeholder check (app-template)
nodes.rationale: Fails generated repos that still contain the 'app-template' placeholder, forcing scripts/init.sh to be run

nodes.label: Tailscale Ingress grocery-ops
nodes.rationale: Exposed on the tailnet as https://grocery-ops.<tailnet> with automatic Tailscale TLS; host must be unique in the tailnet

nodes.label: Dependabot npm nuxt group
nodes.rationale: Groups nuxt, vue and @vite-pwa/* so the coupled framework packages upgrade together

nodes.label: no-kubeconfig hook
nodes.rationale: kubeconfigs live in ~/.kube, outside the repo; committing one always fails

nodes.label: Nuxt 4 monolith (SPA + Nitro API)
nodes.rationale: ssr:false SPA and Nitro server/api in a single Node process and image; npm runs via Docker with node:26-alpine pinned by digest, no local Node

nodes.label: Planned list sync via API + CNPG Postgres
nodes.norm_label: planned list sync via api + cnpg postgres

nodes.label: @vite-pwa/nuxt (manifest + service worker)
nodes.rationale: Service worker is only generated in production builds, so PWA install is tested with make run or the cluster over tailnet HTTPS

nodes.label: grocery-ops PWA
nodes.rationale: Shopping list and cart tracking PWA, installable and offline-capable (precached shell) for use in the supermarket without signal; currently a placeholder showing the API version

nodes.label: Namespaced-only resources (AppProject homelab-apps)
nodes.rationale: No ClusterRole, CRD or webhook allowed by the AppProject

nodes.label: Never version tailnet name, hostname, user or kubeconfig
nodes.norm_label: never version tailnet name, hostname, user or kubeconfig

nodes.label: Hardened security context (non-root uid 1000, read-only root, drop ALL)
nodes.norm_label: hardened security context (non-root uid 1000, read-only root, drop all)
nodes.rationale: Runs as the image's node user (uid 1000); read-only root with /tmp emptyDir for temporary files

nodes.label: kube-linter checks
nodes.rationale: Explicit subset of built-in checks: latest-tag, read-only root fs, run-as-non-root, privilege, cpu/memory requests, probes, dangling-service, host mounts/network, NET_RAW

nodes.label: What the cluster expects (port 8080, /healthz, non-root, namespaced)
nodes.norm_label: what the cluster expects (port 8080, /healthz, non-root, namespaced)

nodes.label: Public repo and GHCR package
nodes.rationale: ArgoCD has no credentials for the personal account, only for the bernats-homelab org

nodes.label: Secrets only in encrypted deploy/**.sops.yaml
nodes.rationale: Encrypted at the final path for WSL + cluster recipients; never use the central CI test key

nodes.label: Shopping Cart Glyph
nodes.rationale: Visual metaphor for the app's purpose: grocery list and cart tracking.

nodes.label: Grocery Ops App Icon (shopping cart)
nodes.rationale: 512x512 SVG with a green (#2f855a) rounded-square background (rx=96) and a white stroked shopping cart (handle, basket, two wheels); square full-bleed design suited to PWA manifest/maskable icons for the grocery list app.
